Track undoes "agent manage untrack": the sessions are in the view again.
Name them as HARNESS:ID or by the start of an id; --all tracks every one.
"agent manage view --untracked --json" lists the untracked ones.

Usage:
  agent manage track [session...] [flags]

Examples:
  agent manage track claude:3f3a9c12-88aa-4c0e-9a51-0f6f0c1d2e3f
  agent manage track --all

Flags:
      --all    Track every untracked session again
  -h, --help   help for track

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
